summary: This experimental document specifies Non-Congestion Robustness for TCP. TCP treats three duplicate acknowledgments as a sign of loss, but packet reordering can trigger this wrongly and hurt performance. TCP-NCR raises the number needed, based on connection state, to better tell real loss from reordering.

eli5.summary: If a few mail packages arrive out of order, you shouldn't panic and say one is lost. This teaches the sender to wait a bit longer before deciding something truly went missing.
